UI_LugliDMS_Hint_crate1: Someone nailed this shut and tucked it out of sight. Probably supplies they meant to come back for.
UI_LugliDMS_Hint_crate2: Nailed shut with care and well hidden. Expect useful gear inside.
UI_LugliDMS_Hint_crate3: Heavily sealed. Whatever is inside was worth protecting.
UI_LugliDMS_Need_pry: a crowbar or a pry bar
UI_LugliDMS_CannotNow: This cannot be done right now.
UI_LugliDMS_Hint_lockbox1: A small locked box kept out of sight. Papers, cash, maybe something worth more.
UI_LugliDMS_Hint_lockbox2: A sturdy lockbox, well hidden. Someone kept their valuables in here.
UI_LugliDMS_Hint_lockbox3: A heavy lockbox with a good lock. Whatever is inside was worth protecting.
UI_LugliDMS_Hint_footlocker1: A padlocked footlocker. Probably gear someone meant to come back for.
UI_LugliDMS_Hint_footlocker2: A footlocker with a solid padlock. Expect useful gear inside.
UI_LugliDMS_Hint_footlocker3: A heavy footlocker, padlocked tight. Whatever is inside was worth protecting.
UI_LugliDMS_KeyCarried: You carry a stash key. It may fit this lock.
UI_LugliDMS_KeyNearby: Its owner kept a key to it, most likely somewhere in this building.
UI_LugliDMS_Need_force: a crowbar or a pry bar
UI_LugliDMS_MayJam: A failed try can jam the lock.
UI_LugliDMS_Spends: A failed try uses up the tool.
UI_LugliDMS_Wears: A failed try wears the lockpick down.
UI_LugliDMS_Wrecks: Wrecks the box: it can't be carried away after.
UI_trait_LugliDMS_LocksmithDesc: Picks locked doors and stash locks with a paperclip or a screwdriver, faster and without ever jamming them, and hears a safe's dial better through a stethoscope.
UI_LugliDMS_Keypad_Prompt_keypadsafe: Type the four-digit code, then press OK.
UI_LugliDMS_Keypad_NoNotes: You carry no notes about this safe.
UI_LugliDMS_Dial_Turn1: Step 1 of 4: turn right and stop on the first number.
UI_LugliDMS_Dial_Turn2: Step 2 of 4: turn left. Changing direction locks in the number before.
UI_LugliDMS_Dial_Turn3: Step 3 of 4: turn right and stop on the third number.
UI_LugliDMS_Dial_Turn4: Step 4 of 4: turn left to the last number, then try the combination.
UI_LugliDMS_Dial_RightFirst: The first number is dialed turning right.
UI_LugliDMS_Dial_Ready: All four numbers are set. Try the combination, or reset to start over.
UI_LugliDMS_NotesCarried: You carry %1 notes about this safe.
UI_LugliDMS_NotesCarriedOne: You carry a note about this safe.
UI_LugliDMS_Keypad_TriesOne: One try left before it locks.
UI_LugliDMS_Keypad_LockedHours: Locked. Try again in about %1 hours.
UI_LugliDMS_Keypad_LockedHour: Locked. Try again in about 1 hour.
UI_LugliDMS_Keypad_LockedMinutes: Locked. Try again in about %1 minutes.
UI_LugliDMS_Keypad_LockedMinute: Locked. Try again in about 1 minute.
UI_LugliDMS_Keypad_NoPower: No power. A battery in its compartment would wake it.
UI_LugliDMS_Hint_dialsafe2: A heavy dial safe. Someone trusted it with what mattered most.
UI_LugliDMS_Hint_dialsafe3: A heavy dial safe in a place that kept valuables. Whatever is inside was worth protecting.
UI_LugliDMS_Hint_keypadsafe2: A keypad safe. Without the code it takes power, skill or a lot of noise.
UI_LugliDMS_Hint_keypadsafe3: A keypad safe where the valuables were kept. Whatever is inside was worth protecting.
UI_LugliDMS_NoPower: The keypad is dead. It needs power.
UI_LugliDMS_Alarm: A failed try sets off the alarm and locks it.
UI_LugliDMS_Burns: Paper, money and food inside may burn.
